name: Article
description: `<article>` block with section-level spacing.

name: Block
description: Plain `<div>` block with block-level spacing.

name: Blockquote
description: Quoted block of text — rendered as `<blockquote>`.

name: Caption
description: `<figcaption>` block — caption text for a `<Figure>`.

name: Card
description: Cards are boxed areas for content to sit within.
snippet:
import { Card, Subheading, Paragraph } from "shelving/ui";

<Card>
  <Subheading>Storage</Subheading>
  <Paragraph>1.2 GB of 5 GB used.</Paragraph>
</Card>

name: Column
description: Flex container that stacks its children as a column by default.

name: Definitions
description: Description list — a sequence of term/value pairs rendered as a `<dl>`.

name: Details
description: A collapsible panel with a title that is always visible, built on native `<details>` and `<summary>`.
snippet:
import { Details, Paragraph } from "shelving/ui";

<Details title="What is shelving?">
  <Paragraph>A TypeScript data toolkit.</Paragraph>
</Details>

name: EmailAddress
description: Show an optional email address string correctly on screen.

name: Figure
description: `<figure>` block with section-level spacing.

name: Footer
description: `<footer>` block with section-level spacing.

name: Grid
description: Grid container that arranges its children in equal-width columns.
snippet:
import { Card, Grid, Paragraph } from "shelving/ui";

<Grid gap="small">
  <Card><Paragraph>Running</Paragraph></Card>
  <Card><Paragraph>Cycling</Paragraph></Card>
  <Card><Paragraph>Swimming</Paragraph></Card>
  <Card><Paragraph>Rowing</Paragraph></Card>
</Grid>

name: Header
description: `<header>` block with section-level spacing.

name: Heading
description: Section heading — renders an `<h2>`.

name: Image
description: Image block — renders an `` with space and width variants applied.

name: Label
description: Label heading, a `<h3>` with a labelly appearance (UPPERCASE but with a smaller text size).

name: List
description: List block — wraps each child in an `<li>` and renders an `<ul>` or `<ol>`.

name: Panel
description: Full-width vertical region that paints the current surface colour. Use to break a page into stacked
snippet:
import { Panel, Block, Title, Paragraph } from "shelving/ui";

<Panel as="header" color="primary">
  <Block width="narrow">
    <Title>Welcome</Title>
  </Block>
</Panel>
<Panel padding="large">
  <Block width="narrow">
    <Paragraph>Each panel is a full-width band; the inner block constrains the content.</Paragraph>
  </Block>
</Panel>

name: Paragraph
description:
Paragraph block of body text — rendered as `

`.
snippet:
import { Paragraph } from "shelving/ui";

<Paragraph>The best widget on the market.</Paragraph>

name: PhysicalAddress
description: Show an optional `AddressData` object correctly on screen.

name: Preformatted
description: Preformatted block of text — rendered as `<pre>`.

name: Prose
description:
A section of longform text containing lots of `

` or `

    ` style elements.

name: Row
description: Flex container that arranges its children as a row by default.

name: Section
description: `<section>` block with section-level spacing.
snippet:
import { Section, Heading, Definitions } from "shelving/ui";

<Section width="narrow">
  <Heading>Account details</Heading>
  <Definitions>
    <dt>Name</dt><dd>Alice Smith</dd>
    <dt>Email</dt><dd>alice@example.com</dd>
    <dt>Plan</dt><dd>Pro</dd>
  </Definitions>
</Section>

name: Subheading
description: Subsection heading — renders an `<h3>`.

name: Title
description: Page title — renders an `<h1>`.

name: Video
description: Video container element.

name: Button
description: Render either a `<button>` or an `<a href="">` styled as a button, based on whether an `onClick` or `href` prop is provided.

name: Field
description: A `<Field>` wraps around a form control/input, to shows a small `<label>` above it.

name: Form
description: Schema-driven form that creates a `FormStore`, provides it via `FormContext`, and validates/submits on submit.

name: FormField
description: Show a `<Field>` (label, input, and message) for a single named property of the current form.

name: FormFields
description: Show a `<Field>` for every property in the current form's schema.

name: FormFooter
description: Show a form footer with a submit button and the form's error message.

name: FormInput
description: Show a `SchemaInput` for a single named property of the current form.

name: FormInputs
description: Show a `SchemaInput` for every property in the current form's schema.

name: FormMessage
description: Show the current form's "main" (unnamed) message as a `<Message>`, or render nothing when there is no message.

name: FormNotice
description: Show the current form's "main" (unnamed) message as a `<Notice>`, or render nothing when there is no message.

name: Progress
description: Show progress as a single continuous horizontal bar, filled to `value` within the `min`–`max` range (matches `getPercent()` and `formatPercent()`).
snippet:
import { Progress } from "shelving/ui";

<Progress value={90} status="success" />
<Progress value={20} status="danger" />
<Progress value={60} color="purple" />

name: Ago
description: Elapsed time — shows an unsigned string like `3m`, `6mo` or `just now` for a past date wrapped in a `<time>` element carrying the machine-readable date.

name: Code
description: Inline code span — renders a `<code>` element.

name: Deleted
description: Deleted text — renders a `<del>` element to mark content removed from a document.

name: Emphasis
description: Emphasised text — renders an `<em>` element for stress emphasis (typically italic).

name: Inserted
description: Inserted text — renders an `<ins>` element to mark content added to a document.

name: Link
description: Inline link — delegates to `<Clickable>`, rendering an `<a>` (when `href` is set), a `<button>` (when `onClick` or `disabled` is set), or a `<span>`.
snippet:
import { Link } from "shelving/ui";

<Link onClick={() => save()}>Save now</Link>

name: Mark
description: Highlighted text — renders a `<mark>` element to call attention to a run of text.

name: Small
description: Small print — renders a `<small>` element for side comments and fine print.

name: Span
description: Styled inline text — renders a `<span>` carrying only the colour and typography variant classes, with no styling of its own.
snippet: import { Span } from "shelving/ui"; on-brand accent

name: Strong
description: Strong importance — renders a `<strong>` element for text of strong importance (typically bold).

name: Subscript
description: Subscript text — renders a `<sub>` element for typographically lowered text (e.g. chemical formulae).

name: Superscript
description: Superscript text — renders a `<sup>` element for typographically raised text (e.g. exponents, footnote markers).

name: Until
description: Remaining time — shows an unsigned string like `6d` or `3w` for a future date wrapped in a `<time>` element carrying the machine-readable date.

name: When
description: Relative time — shows a signed string like `in 6d`, `3w ago` or `just now` wrapped in a `<time>` element carrying the machine-readable date.

name: ArrayCheckboxInputs
description: Output a list of `<CheckboxInput>` elements for each item in an array, to pick any number of them.

name: ArrayInput
description: Repeating input that edits an array of items, adding a `SchemaInput` row per item.

name: ButtonInput
description: Return either a `<button>` or an `<a href="">` styled as an input, based on whether an `onClick` or `href` prop is provided.

name: ChoiceRadioInputs
description: Output a list of `<RadioInput>` elements for each item in a set of `ChoiceOptions` in `{ key: title }` format.

name: DataInput
description: Composite input that edits a data object by rendering a `SchemaInput` for each property schema.

name: DictionaryInput
description: Repeating input that edits a dictionary, with an editable key and schema-validated value per entry.

name: ImageInput
description: Square image picker that shows the picked image in the square.

name: OutputInput
description: Show static read-only content styled as an input, falling back to `placeholder` when empty.

name: PopoverButton
description: Popover variant of `<Button>` — a button that reveals floating popover content beside it when clicked.

name: PopoverButtonInput
description: Popover variant of `<ButtonInput>` — an input-styled button that reveals floating popover content beside it when clicked.

name: QueryCheckboxesInput
description: Combo box that queries a list of items and lets the user pick any number of them, with checkboxes.

name: QueryRadiosInput
description: Combo box that queries a list of items and lets the user pick one, with radios.

name: SchemaField
description: Show the appropriate input for a schema, wrapped in a `<Field>` with its label and message.

name: SelectInput
description: Dropdown input bound to a string value, rendered as a `<select>` of the provided `options`.

name: Menu
description: A `<menu>` list of `<MenuItem>` children.
snippet:
import { Menu, MenuItem } from "shelving/ui";

<Menu>
  <MenuItem href="/dashboard">Dashboard</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem href="/users">
    Users
    <Menu>
      <MenuItem href="/users/active">Active</MenuItem>
      <MenuItem href="/users/archived">Archived</MenuItem>
    </Menu>
  </MenuItem>
  <MenuItem href="/settings">Settings</MenuItem>
</Menu>

name: MenuItem
description: A `<li>` containing an `<a>` link, plus optional submenu content shown when this item is "proud".

name: ErrorNotice
description: Render a caught error as an inline `<Notice>` with a retry button.

name: Icon
description: Render the icon for a given status, coloured to match.
snippet:
import { Icon } from "shelving/ui";

<Icon status="success" size="large" />
<Icon status="error" />
<Icon status="loading" size="small" />

name: Loading
description: Animated loading spinner shaped like a Heroicon — a faint track plus a rotating indicator arc.

name: Markup
description: Parse a markup string and render the resulting elements inline.

name: Tag
description: Small inline label used to annotate other content.
snippet:
import { Tag } from "shelving/ui";

<Tag success>Active</Tag>
<Tag warning href="/billing">Overdue</Tag>
<Tag color="purple" size="small">Beta</Tag>

name: Empty
description: Message for a list with nothing in it: centred, grey content with space around it.
snippet:
import { Empty, Paragraph } from "shelving/ui";

<Empty>
	<Paragraph>No challenges yet.</Paragraph>
</Empty>

name: Notice
description: Block-level status callout with an icon and message, used to highlight feedback.
snippet:
import { Notice } from "shelving/ui";

<Notice status="success">Your changes have been saved.</Notice>
<Notice status="error">Something went wrong.</Notice>
<Notice status="loading" />

name: Notices
description: Render the global list of notices and subscribe to incoming `"notice"` events.

name: Cell
description: Table cell.

name: Table
description: Table block — rendered as `<table>`.
